Rotate them; don't touch `/data/kafka`"},{"text":"In a similar incident the largest consumer of space was /var/log/journal","evidence_ids":["INC-0089#2"],"quote":"`/var/log/journal`, which was by far the largest"}],"next_checks":["Run `df -h /var` and `df -i /var` to confirm space and inode usage","Use `du -xh --max-depth=2 /var | sort -h | tail -15` to locate large directories","Check size of `/var/log/journal` and vacuum with `journalctl --vacuum-size=500M` if needed","Inspect `/var/log/kafka` for excessive GC log files and ensure logrotate is active"]}
